findings: ScanningView disables cancel by comparing phase text to a localized preparing string rather than an explicit cancellable state. UI availability therefore depends on presentation text.

ResultsView used for scans with old results contains a progress strip but no cancel callback or button. The initial-scan ScanningView has cancel; the old-results branch does not expose it in these read ranges.

Old results remain interactive during background scanning: selection, hide-group, incorrect-match flagging and group navigation callbacks are passed without a scan-state guard at ResultsView/ListView/GridView.

If result groups are empty and unreadable summary is hidden, ResultsView shows a no-results message even with unreadable files. The warning can be dismissed; empty results alone are not evidence of complete successful coverage.
Scan scope summary shows at most five paths truncated to final 35 characters and does not explain the previously reviewed empty-include broadening behavior.
Stale warning relative time is remembered by timestamp alone, so it does not age with wall time while mounted. Rescan affordance and persisted-result warning exist, but do not revalidate equality.
Group collections are lazy and keyed by uniqueId. Collision properties depend on the previously reviewed hash/group-ID model; UI keys do not add identity validation.
